precondition: An existing complete app-private download was retained. The run records no account state, gallery text, page URL, image content, screenshot, or local file path.
steps: In the native HDS Reader settings, select the bounded 2-second interval from the same 2/3/5/8/10-second range as NextE; reopen the native Reader and reveal its overlay chrome.
Record only the safe page counter, activate the clock action, then record the counter after two completed intervals: 1 / 55 became 3 / 55.
Activate the same clock action to stop. Record the counter immediately and after a three-second wait: 11 / 55 remained 11 / 55.
Return to HDS Settings and restore the durable default interval to 3 seconds.
result: Passed: auto advance is an explicit Reader-chrome action, waits for a decoded page before starting that page's interval, uses the persisted interval, advances the native Reader, and stops cleanly when toggled off.
cleanup: All temporary device and host accessibility-layout files were removed; the app was returned to its root route and the normal 10000 ms screen-off timeout was restored.
